text:
Brief: Willow work plan

Write a work plan for six components: upload, billing, webhooks, quota, ledger, pricing. Use only these values and rules. The two marked "decided" are my choices.

Settings: webhooks.max_workers=14; pricing.timeout_s=35; billing.retry_limit=5; ledger.timeout_s=95; upload.ttl_s=3600 (decided); database=PostgreSQL (decided).

Derived limits: ledger.timeout_s>85, so quota.retry_limit≤2. billing.retry_limit>3, so quota.batch_size≤200.

Workers: alpha runs webhooks and owns pricing. Billing runs on a different worker from upload. Quota and upload share a worker.

Dependencies: upload depends on pricing. Pricing runs before ledger. Quota has no path to pricing, direct or transitive, and does not depend on upload.

types.py and tokens.py belong to upload. Code review turnaround: under one day.

Ignore legacy values and meeting notes.
